final: WITH wf AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, p.remaingb, (p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref), grp AS (SELECT site_code, insurance_status, AVG(remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(cpu_minus_gpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM wf GROUP BY site_code, insurance_status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remain, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remain / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM grp g JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
